params.class_rule: m2_common.class_of — the CC-M1-11.4 family priority order; the classes PARTITION the roster
params.eras: E1..E8 + FIT/GATE/ALL + calendar years, with the D-058 PRE-EXAM HOLDOUT (d8 >= 20250701) EXCLUDED from every one of them and carried ONLY under its own HOLDOUT_2025H2 label (R58)
params.fires_per_session: n_candidates / n_sessions over the era's sessions in which the ASSET traded, WITH its session-level dispersion (sd, median, p10, p90, zero-fire sessions) — a pooled mean with no spread is not a decision input (R55)
params.value: c_c_roster.certificates(wall_usd, cost_rt) — walled phase-close (adoption) + walled peak-exit (CC-M1-8 companion)
params.winner: cert_close >= $1000 and mae_before_argmax <= $300 and not walled (D-021)
